title: SMOK Pozz Pro Replacement Pods - 3 Pack
description: The new Smok Pozz Pro is a stylish, simple to use, yet surprisingly versatile pod kit. The refillable pods feature a comfortable mouthpiece and can hold 2ml of your favourite e-liquid, using the convenient side port to top up your pod. We recommend using 50/50 , high-PG or nicotine salt e-liquids with the Smok Pozz Pro. The Smok Pozz Pro uses Smok’s LP1 coils [not included], which feature a mesh build for improved longevity and immaculate flavour.
